profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Cox Communications
profile.summary:
Detail-oriented people and project manager with over twenty-five years of experience in the telecommunications and cable industries.  Extensive experience in professional services implementation and delivery, staff management, project management, systems engineering, and network management.  Excellent technical acumen and problem-solving skills with an ability to quickly grasp new systems and procedures.

•	Project Management Professional (PMP)	
•	Staff Management
•	Professional Services Delivery	
•	Systems Engineering and Support
•	Technical Project Management	
•	Legacy and IPTV Video
•	Collaboration	
•	Network Management Systems
•	Change Management
•	Cisco Routers and Switches
•	Solaris/Linux System Administration	
•	Network Engineering

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Instrumental in testing and implementing projects to include transitioning the HFC RF network to a Remote PHY Solution, RF Spectrum Alignment, MPEG2 to MPEG4 video content migrations, system upgrades and integrating new products into the Cox production environment.

Technical and Project Lead responsible for migrating the Cox production simulcrypt broadcast video network from the D9902 Digital Content Manager (DCM) to the Virtual Digital Content Manager (vDCM) platform.  Migrations completed with zero customer impact.

Readily engage with product vendors to review new technology, provide feedback, and help shape the products and technology to best fit the needs of Cox markets.

positions.title: Video Solutions Engineer III
positions.description:
Technical and Project Lead responsible for all aspects of Cisco video solutions projects to include defining project scope, training and scheduling project resources, meeting project timelines and ensuring project costs remain within expected margins.  

Develop process for deploying the Digital Transport Adapter Control System (DTACS), Explorer Controller (EC) and Universal DTA (uDTA) solutions into tier 1 service provider environments.  Streamline and optimize the existing delivery process to recover two weeks per site for a total project savings of $500,000.

Provide Lead Engineering and Implementation support for Service Provider Video customers on all products associated with the DNCS/Explorer Controller (EC), Digital Transport Adapter Control System (DTACS), and Universal DTA Solutions.  Deployment team includes a combination of seven experienced employees and contract resources.

Create technical source material and perform training to peers and customers enabling successful video solutions deployments and migrations on Solaris, Linux, and Windows servers deployed within VMWare environments on Cisco UCS servers and other x86 platforms.

Develop tools utilizing VBA macros and shell scripts to automate the tasks of data collection, formatting and analysis reducing the time for completion to days rather than weeks.

Provide technical content and review of customer proposals.

positions.title: Manager Technical Support
positions.description:
Manage a technical support call center consisting of up to 30 Level I thru IV Customer Support Engineers who respond to service requests and resolve customer system related issues.

Provide Technical and Change Management support for Cisco's Service Provider Video customers on all products in the Digital Broadband Delivery video solution.

Ensure customer support engineers meet or exceed Service Level Agreements (SLA) at varying severity levels.

Decrease time to resolution and case backlog by ensuring case reviews are efficient and relevant, assuring action plans are communicated to stakeholders, and focus on increased technical expertise of engineers.

Work closely with key management in sales and multiple business units to identify and plan for future customer support needs.

Participate in an on call duty manager rotation acting as the single point of contact for high severity service request progress and escalations.

positions.title: Manager, Advanced Services
positions.description:
Advanced Services Manager, managing up to 30 team members, responsible for the successful delivery and execution of more than 450 IPTV and Digital Broadband Delivery Systems projects annually in North America and South America.

Develop processes to certify internal employees and partner resources to perform installation and upgrades of Cisco equipment in a Service Provider environment.

Worked in collaboration with customers, account managers, sales engineers, and business development managers to define customer business requirements and develop statements of work (SOW) during project planning.  Overall goal was to ensure projects were appropriately scoped and the correct effort was defined prior to project commencement.

Performed risk mitigation by identifying, escalating and resolving product and project issues prior to and during field delivery.  This reduced the number of customer impacting issues from more than 30% to less than 2%.

Coordinated training and testing programs to ensure delivery team and partner readiness during project execution.  These programs greatly increased field team preparedness and reduced the number of failures during project implementation.

Wrote Methods of Procedure (MOP) and Acceptance Test Procedures (ATP) for large-scale Hybrid Fiber Coax (HFC) and IPTV video management and delivery systems, simplifying implementation and delivery of professional services projects.
